PLUGGABLE ECONOMETRIC FORMULATION

Jevons vs. Carli: Formula Discrepancy & Ministry Choice

AeroStat gives MoSPI complete institutional freedom: whatever formula the Ministry mandates can be seamlessly integrated. Toggle between Jevons (recommended international standard) and Carli (Ministry legacy approach) in the Overview tab to inspect real-time discrepancies.

⚖
Ministry Integration Guarantee:If MoSPI or NSO requires the legacy Carli or Dutot arithmetic formula for continuity with other CPI modules, AeroStat's architecture toggles it instantly with zero pipeline code changes.
01 / JEVONS FORMULA (RECOMMENDED)

Takes the geometric mean of matched price relatives within each route and booking horizon:

Iᵣ,ₕ = 100 × exp(Σ ln(rⱼ) / n)

Why Jevons is Stable:
• Immune to Price Bouncing: If a fare surges from ₹5k to ₹10k (+100%) and returns to ₹5k (-50%), Jevons calculates √(2.0 × 0.5) = 1.0 (0% artificial inflation).
• Scale Invariant: Proportional changes carry equal weight regardless of absolute ticket price.
• International Benchmark: Mandated by IMF, UN, OECD & UK ONS (2026) for dynamic price data.

02 / CARLI FORMULA (MINISTRY LEGACY OPTION)

Takes the arithmetic mean of matched price relatives across observed flights:

Iᵣ,ₕ = 100 × (Σ rⱼ / n)

Flaws & Discrepancies in CPI:
• Upward Drift Trap: For the identical ₹5k → ₹10k → ₹5k swing, Carli calculates (2.0 + 0.5) / 2 = 1.25 (+25% phantom inflation) even though prices returned to baseline!
• Jensen's Inequality: Arithmetic mean is mathematically greater than geometric mean on volatile prices, causing Carli to systematically overstate true inflation.
• Axiomatic Failure: Violates Time-Reversal Test (I₀,ₜ × Iₜ,₀ > 1).

Match fares→Price relatives (rⱼ)→Jevons or Carli Aggregator→DGCA Traffic Weights (wᵣ)→National Horizon Index
WORKED NUMERICAL DISCREPANCY PROOF

How Dynamic Prices Expose the Carli Flaw

Consider two flights on DEL-BOM: Flight 1 surges from ₹4,000 to ₹8,000 (relative = 2.0). Flight 2 drops from ₹6,000 to ₹3,000 (relative = 0.50).

• Jevons: 100 × √(2.00 × 0.50) = 100 × 1.00 = 100.00 (Stable · 0% Change)
• Carli: 100 × (2.00 + 0.50) / 2 = 100 × 1.25 = 125.00 (+25% Artificial Inflation!)

This discrepancy directly skews CPI transportation inflation reports if volatile dynamic airline prices are fed into an arithmetic Carli formula.

AeroStat Implementation: Use the Index formula dropdown on the Overview screen to switch calculations on the live dataset. Both Jevons and Carli indices are computed in real time across all 6 trunk routes and 5 advance booking horizons.

Connect fare observations

Enter your HTTPS collection API. It must allow this site's origin through CORS and return the JSON format below. The endpoint is saved only in this browser; no API keys should be included in its URL.

Expected response format
{"observations": [{
 "id": "unique-id", "route": "DEL-BOM",
 "horizon": 7, "airline": "IndiGo",
 "flight": "6E 101", "source": "IndiGo",
 "fare": 4500, "departureDate": "2026-10-05",
 "observedAt": "2026-09-28T10:00:00Z"
}]}

Supported routes and base fares are listed in Route explorer. Dates must match the selected observation day and horizon. Fetch requests include observation_date and horizons query parameters. Weights remain illustrative until replaced in the project configuration.
